title: Got a map last night in my dream
content: I was in a dream world location last night and managed to realise where I was, I started walking around everywhere to try and remember as many details as possible. I was stupidly taking photos on my phone like that would help! But suddenly I ‘zoomed’ out of the location and was able to see a huge map of how things were connected and I was so happy! Can I remember the details of this map…. No! All I can remember is a vague image in my mind of it happening and not the details. Maybe next time.
